# Chat.set_title()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.Chat.set_title`

## Signature

```python
async def set_title(title: str) -> bool: ...
```

## Documentation

Bound method *set_title* of [`Chat`](../../types/user_and_chats/Chat.md).

Use as a shortcut for:

```python
await client.set_chat_title(
    chat_id=chat_id,
    title=title
)
```

### Example

```python
await chat.set_title("Lounge")
```

Note:
    In regular groups (non-supergroups), this method will only work if the "All Members Are Admins"
    setting is off.

### Parameters

- **`title`** (`str`)
  New chat title, 1-255 characters.

### Returns

`bool`: True on success.

### Raises

RPCError: In case of Telegram RPC error.
ValueError: In case a chat_id belongs to user.
